# D. Directory Migration (DM_\*) {.unnumbered}

Active Directory was the implicit governance anchor for eleven categories
of infrastructure objects. When AD goes away, each must be migrated to a
modern equivalent with governance preserved. DM_* adapters define the
interface; vendor implementations plug in underneath.

## Leaves

| ID | Adapter | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **D.1** | IPAM Adapter — DM_010 | Source present |
| **D.2** | DNS Adapter — DM_015 | ⚠ *gap — not in registry* |
| **D.3** | DHCP Adapter — DM_016 | ⚠ *gap* |
| **D.4** | PKI / ADCS Adapter — DM_020 | Source present |
| **D.5** | RADIUS / NPS Adapter — DM_030 | Source present |
| **D.6** | LDAP Proxy Adapter — DM_040 | Source present |
| **D.7** | Sync Engine Adapter — DM_050 | Source present |
| **D.8** | Device Management Adapter — DM_060 | Source present |
| **D.9** | NTP Adapter — DM_070 | Source present |
| **D.10** | DFS Adapter — DM_080 | Source present |
| **D.11** | SPN / App Registration — DM_085 | ⚠ *gap* |
| **D.12** | Trust Relationship — DM_090 | ⚠ *gap* |

Canon surface: [modernization/directory-migration.qmd](../../../modernization/directory-migration.html)

## Canon Phase Mapping Requirement (ADR-081)

Every leaf in this subcategory — DNS, PKI, RADIUS, LDAP, DHCP, Sync Engine, Device Management, NTP, DFS, and the SPN / Trust gap-fillers — MUST publish a **Canon Phase Mapping** table at the top of its operational guide, mapping the guide's phases to the canonical six-phase Directory Migration model (Discover → Normalize → Map → Migrate → Validate → Decommission). Per [ADR-081](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/adr/adr-081-directory-migration-phase-canonical-model.md), this requirement applies to every existing and future adapter guide in this taxonomy.

Reference implementations: [DNS Modernization](../network-transformation/dns-modernization.qmd) (11→6 mapping) and [PKI Modernization](../pki-modernization.qmd) (6→6 mapping). Contributor guidance is in [`src/uiao/modernization/directory-migration/README.md`](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/modernization/directory-migration/README.md) under "Adding a New Adapter Migration Guide".
